defaultPrompt: Build an original TouchDesigner shader and a tutorial for it.
Find techniques for my TouchDesigner idea and compare native routes.
Review my TouchDesigner network, GLSL and tutorial.
interface.longDescription: Four skills (research, build, explain, review) help you design an original TouchDesigner shader, its GLSL and network recipe, and a tutorial for it. Works in chat hosts and coding agents. Includes a reference library, eight example studies with real .tox exports, and five liquid-glass studies checked only by glslang compiles, WebGL2 previews and unit tests (not yet run in TouchDesigner, no .tox). Downloads need the host's file tools; otherwise the complete source comes in the chat. Rendering and saving a new .tox need TouchDesigner. Free for non-commercial use (CC BY-NC 4.0): a study started from one of its seeds stays non-commercial and carries a credit. Not a fine-tuned model. Knowledge base: Maxime Heckel's published shader articles and open-source code (blog.maximeheckel.com). This toolkit is built on his work and credits it throughout. It is independent: not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by Maxime Heckel.
